question.text: Which of the following set of characteristics of a material is suitable for using it as a dielectric in a capacitor?

options.text: large dielectric constant and high dielectric strength
large dielectric constant and low dielectric strength
small dielectric constant and high dielectric strength
small dielectric constant and low dielectric strength

solution.text: The material suitable for use as a dielectric in a capacitor must have high dielectric strength and large dielectric constant
